snippet.title: Let's Narcissism: The House (Part 1: 2001)
snippet.description:
Cringe with me as we go through some of the old games I made for Halloweens past. In this episode: My original Sonic fan-character, Blonic. Do not steal.

Download: 
http://www.mediafire.com/download/k6ts5rud7dojkoh/thedarkness_full.exe
